concept.title: System Information
concept.shortdesc: The serial numbers for your system can be found on their product labels.

section.title: Powerwall 3 Serial Number
section.p: Find the serial number on a sticker on the left side of Powerwall 3.

section.title: Backup Gateway 2 Serial Number
section.p: Find the serial number on a sticker on the panel cover of Backup Gateway 2.

section.title: Gateway 3 Serial Number
section.p: Find the serial number on a sticker on the panel cover of Gateway 3.

section.title: Backup Switch Serial Number
section.p: Find the serial number printed on the right side of Backup Switch.
